Intro: Hello, kid. Hope you've been having a better time than I've been. Been tossing and turning all night thinking about… the past few weeks.
I sound like a greenhorn in the trenches long ago. I've seen a lot of things over the years, but that doesn't mean that I'd get over it.
I've been helping whoever I can, but would it ever be enough? I guess I've been trying to treat the wound when someone's still stabbing us, no?
Got anything to pick this old man up? Used to get [DISH] whenever I feel like shit.
Success: Thanks… I needed that. I'm going to try and do more. Somehow, someway. I hope you'll do too.
Fail: That… was not it. Thanks anyways, for entertaining me. I miss your [DISH], darling…
Reject: I see I guessed wrong about our relationship.
